<error: GenericFailure, Cannot start sandboxed command: Bubblewrap cannot start sandboxed commands or services with this policy because its private network is unavailable. (Bubblewrap: sandbox networking requires 'slirp4netns' on PATH: No such file or directory (os error 2). Install slirp4netns.) Network access from the sandbox on Linux requires: bubblewrap (bwrap) 0.5.0 or later, slirp4netns, util-linux 2.35 or later (unshare and nsenter), iptables, ip6tables, iptables-restore and ip6tables-restore, read/write access to /dev/net/tun, and unprivileged user and network namespaces (on Ubuntu 24.04 and later, check kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns; also check user.max_user_namespaces and user.max_net_namespaces). See https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/about-cloud-and-local-sandboxes>
